dossier_meta.paper: Improved lower bound for the list chromatic number of graphs with no $K…
dossier_meta.context_text: Having established the lower bound $(2-o(1))t$ for the maximum list chromatic number of $K_t$-minor free graphs, the author asks whether the probabilistic lower-bound construction is essentially optimal up to lower-order terms, or whether the lower bound can be further improved beyond $2t$.
